theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Myth: You Need Huge Money to Start Investing
body: Reality: Systematic investing allows you to begin with small, manageable amounts regularly, making wealth building accessible to everyone.
caption: Misconceptions about mutual fund investing often prevent people from starting their wealth journey. Understanding the truth helps you make informed choices. #MutualFundMyths #InvestingBasics #WealthBuilding #DebunkingMyths #SmartInvesting
